rationale: REXR is trading at 99.7% of its intraday range with only 33 minutes to close, sitting at the session high after a 2% gap-up and a further ~4% intraday rally on 3.4x relative volume. Chasing a long at the absolute high this late in the session carries extreme reversal risk, while shorting into what has been relentless buying pressure with no news catalyst and strong momentum is equally dangerous. The risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable given the compressed time window and the stock's position at the top of its range.
